title: Turkish Stuffed Pilaf Balls
description: A twist on traditional Turkish pilaf, these bite-sized balls are filled with a flavorful mixture of spices and herbs. Perfect as an appetizer or snack.
instructions: 2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the pilaf, diced tomato, and Turkish spices.
3. Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls, about 1-inch in diameter.
4. Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
5. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the tops are lightly browned.
6. Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
